content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original certificates relating to educational qualifications and experience. One set of photocopies of certificates. An updated biodata. No Objection Certificate (if employed).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may directly attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date and time with all required original certificates, one set of photocopies of certificates relating to their educational qualifications and experience, an updated biodata, and a No Objection Certificate if currently employed. The selection committee will conduct the interview, and its decision shall be final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the PJTAU Graduate Teaching Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 05.11.2026 at 10.00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the PJTAU Graduate Teaching Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Telangana Rythu Vignana Kendra, Mulugu, Old Collectorate complex, besides Thasildhar Office, Mulugu, Pin Code: 506 343.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this PJTAU recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Graduate Teaching Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the PJTAU Graduate Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) Ag. degree to be eligible for the position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the PJTAU Graduate Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 32,000/- per month.

faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and filled on a contractual basis for the year 2026-27.

faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational and experience certificates, one set of photocopies of certificates, an updated biodata, and a No Objection Certificate if employed.

faq.question: Q8. Will candidates receive TA/DA for attending the PJTAU interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.
